note: Two interpretive schools held side by side, not blended. Pick which the app reads from per surface, or use cyclic for structure and traditional for weighting. Minor aspects (major:false) are optional and off by default for the daily MVP.

provenance.traditional: Classical benefic-malefic and dynamic framing; applying/separating = the faster planet moving toward or away from exact.
provenance.cyclic: Humanistic, process-oriented cyclic model: each planet pair runs a cycle from conjunction to conjunction (the lunation cycle as prototype). Waxing half = instinctive/building; waning half = conscious/releasing.

traditional.nature: takes the combined nature of the two planets
traditional.applyingMeaning: The two meanings fuse and intensify as they close in.
traditional.separatingMeaning: The fused theme has peaked and begins to discharge and integrate.

cyclic.meaning: The start of the pair's cycle. A new impulse is sown, instinctive and not yet conscious of itself. Subjective fusion, pure potential.

entries.applyingMeaning: The two meanings fuse and intensify as they close in.
entries.separatingMeaning: The fused theme has peaked and begins to discharge and integrate.

cyclic.meaning: The first step out of the seed. The new impulse begins to differentiate itself, still fragile and barely formed.

traditional.applyingMeaning: Irritation builds that pushes toward action.
